packages.section: Part B §B3 'The evidence pack' with A23 (the final DM's inputs: the before/after pair, the five-line metrics summary, the clips)
packages.note: You own new docs/reviews/M4/evidence/ (index.md and the JSON files only: art_metrics.json, look.json, readability.json, ledger.json, strain_worst10.json; never images or video, captures are never committed) and new docs/milestones/M4-calls/P3-evidence.md. Everything you record goes in captures/m4/evidence/ in your worktree (local, git-ignored); the lead copies what the DM needs. Steps: (1) Record on your worktree, one act per process (tools/capture_bot.sh res://tests/bot/crowd_bot.tscn <dir> "<title>" 6): C1-C14 (titles in tests/bot/acts/look_acts.gd's header table, C12 'Look: extremes'), 'Look: my arms and legs', 'Look: my knockdown', 'Look: tune own hull', and 'Look: final probe' once (its look.json 'final' key and LOOK-FINAL lines); cut each with tools/look_sheets.sh (overview tiles, full-resolution stills, head, hands and body crops). Every bot.log must have 0 SCRIPT ERROR, SHADER ERROR or ERROR lines: report any. (2) Before/after for C1, C2, C5, C7 and C9: the M3 side is captures/m4_before/<slug>/ in the main checkout /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC (for C5, C13 and C9 use captures/m4_before_recut/<slug>/, re-cut with the new act framing); make side-by-side stills at the same frames. Also THE DM PAIR: one still of M3's placeholder Punk and one of the M4 Punk at the same frame and distance (C2's 1 m guard is the obvious one), and a still of each character beside its concept image. (3) Clips, H.264 MP4, 1280x720, at most 10 MB each (ffmpeg -c:v libx264 -crf ~26 -preset slow, trim to the strongest stretch): the 40 s long take at 1 m (C14), a six-Punk fight at 2-10 m (the crowd bot's 'Six Punks, fight' act or the closest act in tests/bot/acts/crowd_acts.gd; record it windowed), and the player's own limbs (from 'Look: my arms and legs': the guard, jab, cross, hook, front kick and the hold's knee). (4) The four feel questions' A/B stills, each at today's default and at its suggested value via CAPTURE_ARGS="--tune=<name>=<value>": hit_flash_fp_max_share 0 vs 0.12 (the hold's knee, 'Look: flash share, hold knees'), hit_flash_finisher_radius_mult 1.0 vs 2.0 (the haymaker, 'Look: flash share, haymaker and finishers'), fp_knockdown_hide_torso false vs true ('Look: my knockdown'), combat_log_hide_while_holding false vs true (C11 'Look: hold the Punk'). (5) The JSON files: art_metrics.json from the DONE-WHEN table that tools/run_tests.sh -gselect=test_m4_done_when.gd prints (every row A1-A14: state PASS or GATE, the figure, the plan's bar, the ratchet); look.json (L1-L5 from the final probe); readability.json (R1-R15 from the 60 s autopilot crowd act with the art drawn, and R4/R8 with the art against the proxies, from 'Look: readability with the art drawn'); ledger.json (Tripo tasks, credits and balance from assets/source/tripo_ledger.jsonl, and the Gemini image count by job file); strain_worst10.json (the A19 worst ten per shipped GLB from test_skinned_art's print). (6) docs/reviews/M4/evidence/index.md: for every judged item J1-J14 (Part B §B2), the act, the frame and the crop that shows it (paths under captures/m4/evidence/), the before/after pairs, the clips with their sizes, the feel A/B pairs, and the five-line metrics summary A23 asks for (budgets; joint fit; A9 framing; perf p95 and spawn hitch from M4-slice-gate.md's interleaved run, marked 'loaded machine, not quiet'; Tripo credits). Report every absolute path the lead needs for the DM (the DM pair, the concept pairs, the three clips, the feel A/B stills), and say honestly what each clip shows.
